riskPlan.target_claim: Across all 28 fixed-seed guided-sim iterations spanning exogenous SOL/USD price shocks from 0 to 6000 bps (0% to -60%), every hard protocol solvency invariant held on the real tesoro_core.so and sim_lst.so binaries: vault LST balance covered open principal at every step, early unlock while debt remained rejected with Custom(6110) (DebtOutstanding), minted yield stayed strictly within the 2-month accrual bound (40,077,776 vs 116,763,898 lamports), and post-repayment unlock returned the full 10 simSOL principal. Crucially, Treasury share outlay for a 1,000-Gema fill_instant_redeem remained flat at 39,999,999 lamports (33.33% of the 0.12 simSOL seeded buffer) across the entire 0-60% SOL/USD crash because tesoro_core prices instant-redeem shares off the Source's locked issuance unit_num/unit_den rather than the post-shock spot PriceFeed — structurally insulating share-denominated Treasury reserves from post-issuance SOL/USD drops. This is evidence over the declared single-position, 2-month native-LST configuration only, not unconditional protocol safety.
expected_failure_modes: Vault principal dilution or under-collateralization during instant redeem or normal yield payouts
Early principal unlock bypassing outstanding Advance debt
Excessive Treasury buffer drain under post-issuance SOL/USD price crashes
Unbounded sim_lst yield minting beyond accrued yield
guided_sim_boundaries: Oracle price updates are driven deterministically via tesoro_core::set_price; Pyth PriceUpdateV2 receiver staleness and confidence checks (take_native_advance_onchain) are out of scope of this sweep.
Simulated yield runs against the real sim_lst.so binary at fixed 7% APY / 4,380x speedup over a single 10 simSOL 2-month position and 0.12 simSOL seeded Treasury.
Cross-chain LayerZero V2 EVM vault messaging (PositionVaultOApp / tesoro_bridge) and SPL stake-pool slashing are verified separately by Foundry invariants and Rust ledger proptests.
known_coverage_limits: Single-position, single-actor lifecycle per iteration (multi-position concurrency and stake-pool rate slashes are covered by Rust ledger stateful proptests).
Does not exercise LayerZero V2 cross-chain bridge instructions or Pyth mainnet receiver accounts.
